title: The Lake Nona Life Project
official: A Community Epidemiology Study Evaluating the Factors Influencing Overall Health and Wellness
summary: The Lake Nona Life Project aims to examine the health and wellness of participants over the course of multiple years, focusing on the links between health and wellness, longevity, quality of life, and human performance.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years or older
* Live and/or work in the Lake Nona Community (proper)
* Able to provide informed consent
* Able to speak and read English

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to speak or communicate in English
* Living outside of the LNLP study map
* Cognitive impairment that would not allow survey completion
* Unable to speak and read English
